18.question: 13. Jenny lost her parents at the age of five. Despite this ______, she managed to become a leading scholar in computer science.
18.explanation:
【解答】五歲喪親雖是不幸，但她仍努力成為頂尖學者。
(A) complaint: 抱怨 (B) misfortune: 不幸 (C) poverty: 貧窮 (D) retreat: 撤退

18.question: 14. The newspaper apologized for releasing false information that had ______ the public to believe toilet paper was in short supply and caused panic buying.
18.explanation:
【解答】報紙發布假訊息誤導大眾恐慌搶購衛生紙。
(A) confronted: 面對 (B) misled: 誤導 (C) forecast: 預測 (D) restrained: 克制

18.question: 15. The glass lid of the pot is ______, and the cook can clearly observe how well the food is prepared.
18.explanation:
【解答】鍋蓋是透明的，廚師可清楚觀察食物狀況。
(A) substantial: 實質的 (B) prosperous: 繁榮的 (C) transparent: 透明的 (D) magnetic: 有磁性的

18.question: 16. Many people ______ Christopher Columbus with the discovery of America, but others question this honor because Native Americans had lived there long before his arrival.
18.explanation:
【解答】很多人將發現美洲的功勞歸給哥倫布。
(A) reward: 獎勵 (B) quote: 引用 (C) define: 定義 (D) credit: 歸功於

18.question: 17. To prevent the spread of disease, we should take the ______ of washing our hands frequently.
18.explanation:
【解答】為了預防疾病傳播，我們應採取洗手這項預防措施。
(A) reputation: 名聲 (B) destination: 目的地 (C) precaution: 預防措施 (D) motivation: 動機

18.question: 18. Sharing profits with employees is an effective way to improve their ______ and thus increase productivity in a company.
18.explanation:
【解答】與員工分享利潤是提升士氣並提高生產力的有效方法。
(A) morale: 士氣 (B) revival: 復甦 (C) perception: 感知 (D) consolation: 安慰

18.question: 19. As he pulled out of the parking lot, Mr. Chuang drove so ______ that he hit several vehicles and almost knocked down a small girl.
18.explanation:
【解答】他開車太過魯莽，撞到車並差點撞到小女孩。
(A) disgracefully: 可恥地 (B) fabulously: 極好地 (C) noticeably: 顯著地 (D) recklessly: 魯莽地

18.question: 20. When the culture center was seriously damaged in a fire, all its prescheduled activities came to an ______ halt.
18.explanation:
【解答】火災導致文化中心損壞，所有活動突然停止。
(A) abrupt: 突然的 (B) extinct: 滅絕的 (C) impressive: 令人印象深刻的 (D) optional: 可選擇的

19.question: 1. When John proposes an idea, people in his office always lend their support. He feels lucky to have ______ like them.
19.explanation: 【解答】同事 (colleagues)。(A) villain 反派 (B) executive 主管 (C) executive (D) intruder 入侵者。

19.question: 2. As last year’s MVP (Most Valuable Player), Joan is ______ to the basketball team. No other player can replace her.
19.explanation: 【【解答】身為去年的最有價值球員，瓊對籃球隊而言是「不可或缺的」。沒有其他球員能取代她。(A) indispensable 不可或缺的 (B) comprehensible 可理解的 (C) affordable 負擔得起的 (D) permissible 可允許的。

19.question: 3. The researcher warned that the results of the study needed to be interpreted with ______ because the sample size was not big enough to make firm conclusions.
19.explanation: 【解答】研究人員警告說，由於樣本數不足以做出確切結論，研究結果需「謹慎」解讀。(A) metaphor 隱喻 (B) caution 謹慎 (C) enthusiasm 熱情 (D) impulse 衝動。

19.question: 4. Although the small group of soldiers was greatly ______ by their enemy, they fought with great courage and finally won the battle.
19.explanation: 解答】儘管這群小隊士兵在數量上被敵人「遠遠超過」，他們仍勇敢戰鬥並最終贏得了勝利。 (A) initiated 開始 (B) contradicted 反駁 (C) outnumbered 數量上被超過 (D) triggered 觸發。

19.question: 5. Mr. Wise received an award for his ______ to the needy children and the elderly in the neighborhood.
19.explanation: 【解答】奉獻 (devotion)。因對弱勢兒童與長者的奉獻而獲獎。

19.question: 6. One simple yet good way to ______ your love for your family is to express it directly in words.
19.explanation: 【解答】懷斯先生因對鄰里貧困兒童與長者的「奉獻」而獲頒獎項。(A) competence 能力 (B) prospect 前景 (C) momentum 動能 (D) devotion 奉獻。

19.question: 7. Cloning animals has been very controversial. Some people consider it a medical breakthrough, while others think it is ______ and should be prohibited.
19.explanation: 【解答】動物複製一直極具爭議。有些人認為它是醫學突破，但其他人認為它「不道德」且應被禁止。(A) legitimate 合法的 (B) inclusive 包含的 (C) unethical 不道德的 (D) nonmilitant 非好戰的。

19.question: 8. Animals that stay in groups are more likely to find food and detect danger than a ______ animal—multiple pairs of eyes are better than one.
19.explanation: 【解答】群居動物比「獨居」動物更容易找到食物並察覺危險——多雙眼睛勝過一雙。(A) contagious 具傳染性的 (B) rigid 僵硬的 (C) distinctive 獨特的 (D) solitary 獨居的。

19.question: 9. On the first page of her new book, the writer ______ all the people who helped in the publication of the book.
19.explanation: 【解答】在新書的首頁，作者「感謝」了所有協助這本書出版的人。

19.question: 10. Due to the recession, it is not easy for people to get ______ paid jobs, even if they are highly educated and well-trained in the field.
19.explanation: 【解答】體面地/相當地 (decently)。經濟衰退時，難以找到薪水體面的工作。(A) contemplates 深思(B) acknowledges 感謝/承認 (C) inquires 詢問 (D) regulates 管理。

19.question: 11. The sign in front of the Johnsons’ house says that no one is allowed to set foot on their ______ without permission.
19.explanation: 【【解答】強森一家房子前的告示牌寫著，未經許可，任何人不得踏上他們的「私人財產」。(A) margin 邊緣 (B) shelter 庇護所 (C) reservation 預約 (D) property 私人財產。

19.question: 12. Instead of giving negative criticism, our teachers usually try to give us ______ feedback so that we can improve on our papers.
19.explanation: 【解答】老師通常試著給予我們「建設性的」回饋，而不是負面的批評，這樣我們才能改進報告。(A) absolute 絕對的 (B) constructive 建設性的 (C) influential 有影響力的 (D) peculiar 獨特的。

19.question: 13. A study shows that the chance of an accident is much higher for drivers who are ______ in phone conversations while driving.
19.explanation: 【解答】研究顯示，開車時「忙於」講電話的駕駛，發生事故的機率高得多。 (A) contained 包含 (B) engaged 忙於 (C) included 包括 (D) located 位於。

19.question: 14. Mike trembled with ______ and admiration when he saw the magnificent view of the waterfalls.
19.explanation: 【解答】當麥克看到瀑布壯麗的景色時，他因「敬畏」與欽佩而顫抖。(A) awe 敬畏 (B) plea 懇求 (C) oath 誓言 (D) merit 優點。

19.question: 15. Ms. Chen has a large collection of books and most of them are quite heavy; she needs a bookshelf ______ enough to hold all of them.
19.explanation: 【解答】陳老師有大量的藏書，且多數很重；她需要一個「堅固」到足以承載它們的書架。(A) coarse 粗糙的 (B) vigorous 有活力的 (C) portable 可攜帶的 (D) sturdy 堅固的。

19.question: 16. The athlete rolled up his sleeves to show his ______ forearms, thick and strong from years of training in weight-lifting.
19.explanation: 【解答】這位運動員捲起袖子展示他「肌肉發達」的前臂，因多年舉重訓練而顯得粗壯有力。(A) barren 貧瘠的 (B) chubby 圓胖的 (C) ragged 破爛的 (D) muscular 肌肉發達的。

19.question: 17. Suffering from a serious financial crisis, the car company is now on the edge of ______, especially with the recent sharp decrease in its new car sales.
19.explanation: 【解答】這家汽車公司正深受嚴重金融危機之苦，尤其近期新車銷量急劇下降，正處於「破產」邊緣。(A) graduation 畢業 (B) capacity 容量 (C) depression 蕭條 (D) bankruptcy 破產。

19.question: 18. After the rain, the meadow ______ under the sun with the droplets of water on the grass.
19.explanation: 【解答】閃爍/閃耀 (glistened)。雨後草地在陽光下閃閃發亮。(A) rippled 起漣漪 (B) shattered 粉碎 (C) glistened 閃耀 (D) mingled 混合。

19.question: 19. The Great Wall of China was originally built to ______ the northern border of the country against foreign invasion.
19.explanation: 【解答】中國的萬里長城最初是為了「加強防禦」北方的國界以抵禦外敵入侵而建的。(A) fortify 加強防禦(B) rehearse 預演 (C) diminish 減少 (D) strangle 勒死。

19.question: 20. A mad scientist in a novel is often portrayed as a wild-eyed man with crazy hair, working ______ in a lab full of strange equipment and bubbling test tubes.
19.explanation: 【解答】小說中的瘋狂科學家常被描繪成一個瞪大眼睛、髮型怪異的人，在充滿奇怪設備與冒泡試管的實驗室中「瘋狂地」工作。(A) contagiously 傳染性地 (B) distinctively 獨特地 (C) frantically 瘋狂地 (D) tremendously 極大地。

20.question: 1. Martha has been trying to ______ her roommate since their quarrel last week, as she doesn’t want to continue the argument.
20.explanation: 【解答】為了不繼續爭吵，她試著避開室友。(A) overgrow 生長過快 (B) bother 打擾 (C) pursue 追求 (D) avoid 避開。

20.question: 2. As David finished the last drop of the delicious chicken soup, he licked his lips and gave out sounds of ______.
20.explanation: 【解答】喝完湯發出滿足的聲音。(A) contentment 滿足 (B) dominance 優勢 (C) explosion 爆炸 (D) affection 喜愛。

20.question: 3. After several rounds of intense fighting, the boxer punched his ______ right in the face, knocked him out, and won the match.
20.explanation: 【解答】拳擊手重擊他的對手臉部，將其擊倒並贏得比賽。(A) performer 表演者 (B) attendant 服務員 (C) opponent 對手 (D) messenger 信使。

20.question: 4. Watch out! The bench has just been painted. You can fan the wet paint if you want to ______ its drying.
20.explanation: 【解答】風乾油漆需加快速度。(A) fasten 繫緊 (B) hasten 加速 (C) lengthen 延長 (D) strengthen 加強。

20.question: 5. Warm milk ______ sleepiness. So if you have trouble falling asleep, try drinking some warm milk before going to bed.
20.explanation: 【解答】溫牛奶有助於產生睡意。(A) conceal 隱藏 (B) recruit 招募 (C) absorb 吸收 (D) induce 誘發。

20.question: 6. Having worked five years as a data processor in a small town, Alice is tired of the routine of her job and the ______ of her life.
20.explanation: 【解答】厭倦了日復一日的單調生活。(A) disturbance 干擾 (B) salvation 救贖 (C) remainder 剩餘 (D) monotony 單調。

20.question: 7. Peter has never been on time to meetings or appointments. It would be interesting to look into reasons why he is ______ late.
20.explanation: 【解答】形容習慣性遲到。(A) chronically 長期地 (B) hysterically 歇斯底里地 (C) simultaneously 同時地 (D) resistantly 抵抗地。

20.question: 8. The film Life of Pi won Ang Lee an Oscar in 2013 for Best Director—one of the most ______ awards in the movie industry.
20.explanation: 【解答】奧斯卡是許多人夢寐以求的獎項。(A) populated 居住 (B) surpassed 超越 (C) coveted 令人垂涎的 (D) rotated 輪轉。

20.question: 9. According to environmental scientists, the earth is likely to experience significant ______ changes within the next century.
20.explanation: 【解答】氣候變遷造成生態變化。(A) provincial 省級的 (B) ecological 生態的 (C) authentic 真實的 (D) redundant 多餘的。

20.question: 10. Traditional Chinese medical practices include ______ remedies, which use plants, plant parts, or a mixture of these to prevent or cure diseases.
20.explanation: 【解答】中醫常使用草藥。(A) herbal 草本的 (B) frantic 瘋狂的 (C) magnetic 磁性的 (D) descriptive 描述性的。

20.question: 11. Gorillas have often been portrayed as a fearful animal, but in truth these shy apes ______ fight over sex, food, or territory.
20.explanation: 【解答】大猩猩其實性格害羞，鮮少打架。(A) constantly 經常 (B) shortly 不久 (C) nearly 幾乎 (D) rarely 很少。

20.question: 12. With her nine-to-five job, Sally sometimes has to run personal ______ during the lunch break, such as going to the bank or mailing letters.
20.explanation: 【解答】跑腿/雜事。(A) affair 事務 (B) errand 雜事 (C) belonging 財物 (D) connection 連接。

20.question: 13. After an argument with the parents of his students, the teacher finally admitted his mistake and ______ himself to ask for their forgiveness.
20.explanation: 【解答】放低姿態以求原諒。(A) resist 抵抗 (B) humble 謙卑 (C) detect 偵測 (D) handle 處理。

20.question: 14. Instead of criticizing other people, we should focus on their strengths and give them ______.
20.explanation: 【解答】應該多讚美他人。(A) compliment 讚美 (B) compromise 妥協 (C) conviction 定罪 (D) confession 坦白。

20.question: 15. Taking advantage of a special function of the search engine, users can ______ the Internet without leaving behind any history of the webpages they visit.
20.explanation: 【解答】瀏覽網頁。(A) browse 瀏覽 (B) stride 大步走 (C) rumble 發出隆隆聲 (D) conceal 隱藏。

20.question: 16. Due to extremely low rainfall and a dangerous reduction of reservoir water, the area is experiencing the worst ______ in 30 years.
20.explanation: 【解答】乾旱導致水庫水位下降。(A) fluid 流體 (B) scandal 醜聞 (C) drought 乾旱 (D) nuisance 討厭的人事物。

20.question: 17. On Teachers’ Day we pay ______ to Confucius for his contribution to the philosophy of education.
20.explanation: 【解答】致敬。(A) consent 同意 (B) tribute 致敬 (C) devotion 奉獻 (D) preference 偏好。

20.question: 18. When the fire fighter walked out of the burning house with the crying baby in his arms, he was ______ as a hero by the crowd.
20.explanation: 【解答】被稱頌為英雄。(A) preview 預覽 (B) caution 警告 (C) doom 註定失敗 (D) hail 歡呼/稱頌。

20.question: 19. Due to the worldwide recession, the World Bank’s forecast for next year’s global economic growth is ______.
20.explanation: 【解答】全球經濟預測慘澹。(A) keen 敏銳的 (B) mild 溫和的 (C) grim 嚴峻的 (D) foul 汙穢的。

20.question: 20. Jeffery has always been a ______ person, so it’s not surprising he got into an argument with his colleagues.
20.explanation: 【解答】好爭吵的人。(A) respective 分別的 (B) preventive 預防的 (C) contagious 傳染性的 (D) quarrelsome 好爭吵的。

21.question: 1. The government's decision to cut subsidies has ______ significant public opposition.
21.explanation: 【解答】政府削減補貼的決定「激起」了巨大的公眾反對聲浪。(A) provoked 激起 (B) facilitated 促進 (C) withdrawn 撤回 (D) endorsed 背書

21.question: 2. Despite the __________ evidence presented by the prosecution, the jury remained unconvinced of the defendant's guilt.
21.explanation: 【解答】儘管檢方提出了「強而有力」的證據，陪審團仍對被告是否有罪感到懷疑。(A) compelling 強而有力的 (B) ambiguous 模糊的 (C) trivial 瑣碎的 (D) fleeting 短暫的

21.question: 3. The university has decided to __________ the curriculum to include more practical skills for future employment.
21.explanation: 【解答】大學決定「翻新」課程，納入更多未來就業所需的實用技能。(A) revamp 改良 (B) stagnate 停滯 (C) dismantle 拆解 (D) suppress 壓抑

21.question: 4. His __________ understanding of the subject matter enabled him to answer all the complex questions with ease.
21.explanation: 【解答】他對該學科「深厚」的理解使他能輕鬆回答所有複雜的問題。(A) superficial 表面的 (B) profound 深厚的 (C) negligible 可忽略的 (D) hasty 倉促的

21.question: 5. The company took __________ measures to prevent the spread of the virus among its employees.
21.explanation: 【解答】公司採取了「激烈」的措施來防止病毒在員工間傳播。(A) drastic 激烈的 (B) negligent 疏忽的 (C) tentative 試探性的 (D) lax 鬆懈的

21.question: 6. The report __________ the importance of investing in renewable energy sources to combat climate change.
21.explanation: 【解答】這份報告「強調」了投資再生能源以對抗氣候變遷的重要性。(A) underscores 強調 (B) undermines 削弱 (C) obliterates 毀滅 (D) distorts 扭曲

21.question: 7. Many people believe that urbanization is an __________ process, leading to the rapid growth of cities worldwide.
21.explanation: 【解答】許多人認為都市化是一個「不可避免」的過程，導致全球城市快速成長。(A) inevitable 不可避免的 (B) erratic 不穩定的 (C) obsolete 過時的 (D) ambivalent 矛盾的

21.question: 8. The politician's speech was full of __________ arguments that failed to address the core issues of the economic crisis.
21.explanation: 【解答】該政客的演講充滿了「謬誤的」論點，未能解決經濟危機的核心問題。(A) fallacious 謬誤的 (B) coherent 連貫的 (C) lucid 清晰的 (D) valid 有效的

21.question: 9. Technological advancements have __________ the way we communicate with people on the other side of the globe.
21.explanation: 【解答】科技進步「徹底變革」了我們與地球另一端人們溝通的方式。(A) revolutionized 變革 (B) retarded 阻礙 (C) congested 擁塞 (D) depleted 耗盡

21.question: 10. The athlete's __________ dedication to his training regimen eventually led him to win the gold medal.
21.explanation: 【解答】這名運動員對訓練計畫「不動搖的」投入，最終讓他贏得金牌。(A) unwavering 堅定的 (B) sporadic 偶發的 (C) indifferent 冷漠的 (D) volatile 不穩定的

21.question: 11. The environmental impact of plastic pollution is becoming __________ to all nations, necessitating global cooperation.
21.explanation: 【解答】塑膠污染對環境的影響正變得對所有國家「明顯可見」，因此需要全球合作。(A) manifest 明顯的 (B) obscure 模糊的 (C) implicit 暗示的 (D) negligible 微不足道的

21.question: 12. In his autobiography, he describes the __________ hardships he faced during his childhood in a war-torn country.
21.explanation: 【解答】他在自傳中描述了他在飽受戰爭蹂躪的國家度過童年時所面臨的「艱鉅」困境。(A) formidable 艱鉅的 (B) trivial 瑣碎的 (C) superficial 表面的 (D) frivolous 輕浮的

21.question: 13. The professor provided a __________ explanation of the complex theory, making it easy for the students to grasp the main concepts.
21.explanation: 【解答】教授針對複雜理論提供了「清晰易懂的」解釋，使學生容易掌握核心概念。(A) lucid 清晰的 (B) vague 模糊的 (C) ambiguous 模稜兩可的 (D) cryptic 神秘難解的

21.question: 14. Despite the __________ setbacks he encountered, he remained committed to achieving his long-term goals.
21.explanation: 【解答】儘管遇到了「許多的」挫折，他仍致力於達成長期目標。(A) numerous 許多的 (B) negligible 可忽略的 (C) minimal 最少的 (D) insignificant 無關緊要的

21.question: 15. The government is planning to __________ new legislation to protect the rights of minority groups.
21.explanation: 【解答】政府計畫「實施」新法規以保障少數群體的權利。(A) implement 實施 (B) hinder 阻礙 (C) obstruct 阻擋 (D) thwart 挫敗

21.question: 16. The sudden change in market trends __________ the company's financial stability.
21.explanation: 【解答】市場趨勢的突然改變「威脅」了公司的財務穩定。(A) threatened 威脅 (B) fortified 加強 (C) bolstered 支持 (D) reinforced 加強

21.question: 17. A __________ of studies have shown that regular exercise contributes significantly to physical and mental well-being.
21.explanation: 【解答】「無數的」研究顯示規律運動對身心健康有顯著貢獻。(A) myriad 無數的 (B) paucity 少量 (C) scarcity 缺乏 (D) dearth 缺乏

21.question: 18. The team __________ their efforts to finish the project before the deadline.
21.explanation: 【解答】團隊「加倍」了他們的努力，以在期限前完成計畫。(A) redoubled 加倍 (B) attenuated 減弱 (C) diminished 減少 (D) neglected 忽視

21.question: 19. The lawyer presented __________ evidence to prove the innocence of her client.
